scripts.dev: npm run index && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply wenshuoge-metrics --local && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js dev --local
scripts.check: npm run index && npm run audit && npm run typecheck && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.migrate:remote: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply wenshuoge-metrics --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run index && npm run migrate:remote && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy
